# FX gain B, run time (test)

The same effect as `test/dyn-fx-gain` under another module id, so with another effect ID (`register::effect_id`), and with other defaults (GAIN 0.25, MIX 64): the second effect of the
persistence scenario (`tests/digikit/scenarios/fx-persist-dt2.toml`), which checks that a kit gives an effect its own stored values only.
